text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Phew! That wraps up today's
training. Man, I'm starving~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Wait, is that...
Biko-chan running over from over there?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Bono!
Did you just finish up training?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Is Biko-chan all done too?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Just a little more for me!
I'm running while keeping an eye on the academy grounds!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Evil lurks in the dark... but don't worry!
I'll protect the academy's peace!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Biko-chan... Buono☆
Would it be okay if I joined in on your patrol too?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Even if bad enemies show up,
isn't it safer with two people instead of one?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I understand not wanting to let an underclassman walk down dark paths alone, even if it's on academy grounds.
Still, wouldn't that lead to overworking herself?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I understand not wanting to let an underclassman walk down dark paths alone, even if it's on academy grounds.
Still, wouldn't that lead to overworking herself?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Hishi Akebono dashed off on a patrol run
that doubled as her personal training.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...I see, running any more today might affect tomorrow, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, we're counting on you, Trainer!
Do your best for the peace of the academy~!"
